note: Both sets read the five spanwise curves and both contain redundant near-duplicate claims with slightly conflicting values (e.g., 95% vs 100% relative thickness at r/R=0, 15 vs 15.5 deg twist at root, 20% vs 22% thickness at tip). Set A captures the distinctive features better: the chord maximum (~5.8 m at r/R≈0.25), the pitch-axis minimum (~29% at r/R≈0.55), prebend ≈ -1 m at r/R=0.6, and the correct tip chord (~0.6 m). Set B omits the chord peak and adds clear misreads — chord 1.5 m at r/R=1.0 (curve is ~0.5 m) and relative thickness 40% at r/R=0.25 (curve is ~35%) — plus three mutually inconsistent twist values at the root. A's main error is chord 5.2 m at r/R=0.2 (curve is ~5.7 m) and a few duplicate claims differing by rounding.
